# m.partners.fable.merchant_aggregates

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Daily European consumer spending per merchant, from Fable Data's transaction panel.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.fable.merchant_aggregates(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `TransactionDate`, `PublishedDate`, `Name`, `Type`, `UserCountry`, `Channel`, `ConsumerType`, `MccGroup` and `TransactionCurrency`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first transaction day. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last transaction day. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"transaction_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"parent_name": "Amazon Inc"}`. Keys: `channel`, `channel_any_of`, `consumer_type`, `consumer_type_any_of`, `name`, `name_any_of`, `name_gt`, `name_gte`, `name_lt`, `name_lte`, `parent_name`, `parent_name_any_of`, `parent_name_gt`, `parent_name_gte`, `parent_name_lt`, `parent_name_lte`, `user_country`, `user_country_any_of`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Merchant Aggregates (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant | 30-day delayed, All history |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant Business | 7-day delayed, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Channel` | String | Transaction channel. Possible values: online, offline, bnpl (buy now pay later platforms such as Scala, Klarna, Zilch). |
| `ConsumerType` | String | The panel the account is sourced from. Possible values: consumer_credit, consumer_debit, open_banking. |
| `EightDayRollingCategoryAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 8 days. Used for short-term normalization calculations (e.g., spend per 1000 panelists = (total_spend / eight_day_rolling_category_accounts) * 1000). |
| `EightDayRollingTotalAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 8 days. Provides a baseline for total panel size. |
| `MccGroup` | String | Merchant category code group associated with the merchant or payment processor. |
| `MerchantIndustry` | String | Industry name based on GICS/BICS/ICB data classification for the merchant. |
| `MerchantTicker` | String | Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg tickers and they are point in time. |
| `Name` | String | The merchant or entity name for this aggregate (lowercase). When type is 'merchant', this value can be used as the lookup_name in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint to retrieve full corporate hierarchy details. |
| `ParentName` | String | Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands. Also available in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint for full corporate structure. |
| `PublishedDate` | String | The date when this data version was published. For original data, this is approximately 7 days after transaction_date. |
| `SpendInDistinctAccountKeyCount` | long | The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with inbound transactions. |
| `SpendInSpend` | double | The total inbound transaction amount (refunds, returns, credits) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are positive, representing money flowing back into consumer accounts. |
| `SpendInTransactionCount` | long | The count of inbound transactions (refunds, returns). |
| `SpendOutDistinctAccountKeyCount` | long | The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with outbound transactions. |
| `SpendOutSpend` | double | The total outbound transaction amount (money spent by consumers) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are negative, representing money flowing out of consumer accounts. |
| `SpendOutTransactionCount` | long | The count of outbound transactions (purchases, payments). |
| `TotalAccounts` | long | The total count of distinct consumer accounts with any transaction activity for this aggregation. |
| `TotalSpend` | double | Sum of spend_out_spend and spend_in_spend. Typically negative (net outflow). A positive value indicates refunds exceeded new spending for this aggregation. |
| `TotalTransactions` | long | The total count of all transactions (outbound + inbound). |
| `TransactionCurrency` | String | ISO currency code for the transaction (base card/account currency). Always EUR or GBP in this dataset. All spend amounts are denominated in this currency. |
| `TransactionDate` | String | The calendar date when the consumer transactions occurred. |
| `TwentyEightDayRollingCategoryAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 28 days. Used for longer-term normalization calculations. |
| `TwentyEightDayRollingTotalAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 28 days. Provides a longer-term baseline for total panel size. |
| `Type` | String | The type of aggregation. Can be 'merchant' or 'payment_processor'. |
| `UserCountry` | String | Country of consumer's residence (ISO codes). Available countries: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, AT. Values outside these are mapped to 'unknown'. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
